Percy Bicknell, of the Valley, was the individual winner, followed by Cohen (Ashcombe) and Mick Pyer (Belgrave). Three weeks later a similar fixture was held at Wimbledon over a five miles course, and ninety runners finished.

In 1928 we travelled(over thirty of us) to the Valley's quarters at Feltham, and the race was won by Percy Bicknell of TVH, with the long-legged hairpin-thin subject of this article, running in Ashcombe AC colour in second place.

… energies for the full 5 miles found them wasted when sighting the finish a full mile short. Result: 1.A.Clark (Bels) 2.P.V.Bicknell (TVH) 3.H.E.Footer (Bels) Belgrave H 158pts, TVH 220pts, Ashcombe AC 337pts.…
